# NavigationLink

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("NavigationLink")`

Connects two points that the walkable ground does not join: a gap to jump, a ladder or a drop. A path can use the link. The third value `FindPath` returns gives the link's `Label` at the waypoint where the link begins, so the script that follows the path knows to jump there instead of walking. Both points are in world space, and each must be near walkable ground.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Bidirectional` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the link can also be taken from `To` back to `From`. A ladder can; a drop cannot. |
| `From` | `vector` | — | read/write | The position where the link starts, in world space. |
| `Label` | `string` | `"Jump"` | read/write | A name for the kind of crossing, reported in the path. |
| `To` | `vector` | — | read/write | The position where the link ends, in world space. |
